value.signature: fn compare_paper_boundary (candidate : & PaperCaseBoundary , selected : Option < & BoundaryContext > , consumer : & impl BoundaryConsumer ,) -> Checked < () >

review.body: { let Some (selected) = selected else { return Checked :: Unavailable (Inability :: UnavailableContext) ; } ; let context = match forward_consumer (consumer . required_boundary_context (selected)) { Ok (value) => value , Err (other) => return failed_checked (& other) , } ; compare_paper_boundary_under (candidate , selected , consumer , & context) }
review.item_premise: The conditional component comparison reads public supplied context, typed values and explicit evaluator premises; it retains inability and refusal separately. No production evaluator, authenticated history or deployment authority is supplied by this operation.
